rules: Overlines must be uppercase and wide spaced (tracking-widest).
Body text should have relaxed line-height (leading-relaxed).
Never use pure black (#000000). Use Charcoal (#2D2A2E).
Primary color is for CTAs only.
Backgrounds should not be pure white, use Porcelain (#FDFCFB) for warmth.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise/grain overlay on backgrounds to avoid digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.radius: Rounded-xl or Rounded-2xl for a softer, friendlier feel.

landing_page.hero: Split screen or Centered with large typography and floating images.

booking_flow.interaction: Large clickable areas for mobile users.

admin_panel.style: Clean, high-density but with breathing room.

buttons.style: Pill-shaped or Soft Rounded (rounded-full or rounded-xl).
buttons.animation: Scale down on click (active:scale-95), subtle lift on hover.

cards.style: Flat with subtle border, or soft shadow hover lift.

inputs.style: Shadcn Input with customized border colors (focus:ring-rose-200).

hero.description: Artistic hand with finger extended, soft lighting

interior.description: White wooden drawer with pink cushion, minimalist

services.description: Woman's hands with red nail polish

motion.entrance: Fade in up (opacity-0 translate-y-4 -> opacity-100 translate-y-0)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1). Use dark charcoal for text on pastel backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-rose-300) for keyboard navigation.
accessibility.labels: All inputs must have visible labels or aria-labels.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the booking flow as a multi-step form.
Admin panel must be protected (mock auth is fine if backend not ready).
Do not use generic 'Lorem Ipsum', use realistic beauty salon copy in Russian.
Ensure mobile responsiveness is top priority (80% of users are on mobile).
Use the provided image URLs for specific sections.
Apply the 'Porcelain & Rose Gold' color palette strictly.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' aesthetics (generic gradients, centered everything).
Add micro-interactions to every clickable element.
